answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be faked by copying. Require every agent to lock a ferrous stake — real, scarce capital that rusts away if the agent misbehaves — before it can earn. One operator spinning up a thousand clones then pays a thousand stakes, while a lone honest agent pays once. The jade test is durability: cheap identities fade, staked ones endure. Any scheme promising free trust is a fable; trust must be bought with something the attacker cannot print.
